```{r dash-rt-sla, results='asis', echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
library(flexdashboard)
library(purrr)
library(dplyr)
library(knitr)
source(here::here(".engine/Utilities", "utils.R"))

if (!exists("planitDarkGrey")) planitDarkGrey <- "darkgrey"

# ── Get sequence_num per run to identify current and sort correctly ──
run_order <- raw_data %>%
  group_by(run_id) %>%
  summarise(sequence_num = first(sequence_num), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(sequence_num))   # current run (highest seq) first

current_run_id    <- run_order$run_id[1]
run_ids_in_report <- run_order$run_id   # ordered: current first, older after

ticks <- "```"
box_template <- paste0(
  "### %s Response Time\n\n",
  ticks, "{r, echo=FALSE}\n",
  "flexdashboard::valueBox(\n",
  "  value   = '%s',\n",
  "  caption = HTML('%s'),\n",
  "  icon    = '%s',\n",
  "  color   = '%s'\n",
  ")\n",
  ticks, "\n"
)

src <- map_chr(run_ids_in_report, function(rid) {

  is_current <- (rid == current_run_id)
  rt_result  <- get_run_rt_sla(rid)

  if (is.null(rt_result)) {
    value_text   <- "N/A"
    caption_text <- "<b>Response Time</b><br><br>No response time SLA defined."
    box_color    <- planitDarkGrey
    box_icon     <- if (is_current) "fa-stopwatch" else "fa-history"

  } else {

    # ── Evaluate SLA at Thread Group (User Journey) Level ──
    run_journeys <- raw_data %>% filter(run_id == rid)

    breached_labels <- if (!is.null(rt_result$top_breaches) && nrow(rt_result$top_breaches) > 0) {
      rt_result$top_breaches$label
    } else {
      character(0)
    }

    # Summarise pass/fail per Thread Group using raw_data$thread_group
    journey_summary <- run_journeys %>%
      group_by(thread_group) %>%
      summarise(
        has_breach = any(label %in% breached_labels),
        .groups = "drop"
      )

    total_journeys  <- nrow(journey_summary)
    failed_journeys <- sum(journey_summary$has_breach)
    passed_journeys <- total_journeys - failed_journeys

    # value_text <- sprintf("%d / %d user journeys failed", failed_journeys, total_journeys)
    value_text <- sprintf("%d / %d user journeys passed", passed_journeys, total_journeys)

    # ── SLA color only for current run ──
    box_color <- if (!is_current) {
      planitDarkGrey
    } else if (failed_journeys == 0) {
      "success"
    } else {
      "danger"
    }

    # ── Icon — history for older runs, status for current ──
    box_icon <- if (!is_current) {
      "fa-stopwatch"
    } else if (failed_journeys == 0) {
      "fa-check-circle"
    } else {
      "fa-times-circle"
    }

    if (nrow(rt_result$top_breaches) > 0) {
      breach_lines <- rt_result$top_breaches %>%
        mutate(
          line = sprintf(
            "%s &mdash; %s%% over (%dms vs %dms SLA)",
            label, breach_pct, actual_rt, threshold
          )
        ) %>%
        pull(line)

      breach_html <- paste(
        sprintf("%d. %s", seq_along(breach_lines), breach_lines),
        collapse = "<br>"
      )

      caption_text <- sprintf(
        "<b>%s Response Time</b><br><br>Worst transaction breaches (%s vs SLA):<br>%s",
        toupper(rt_result$metric), toupper(rt_result$metric), breach_html
      )
    } else {
      caption_text <- sprintf(
        "<b>%s Response Time</b><br><br>All %d user journeys transactions passed SLA.",
        toupper(rt_result$metric), total_journeys
      )
    }
  }

  sprintf(box_template, rid, value_text, caption_text, box_icon, box_color)
})

cat(knit(text = paste(src, collapse = "\n"), quiet = TRUE))
```
